Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classes24.Item.phbinvPactBlade0]{Pact of the Blade} Invocation.

You gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only. With that feature, you can attack twice with the weapon instead of once when you take the &Reference[Attack] action on your turn.
